description: This Mendeley Data deposit collects renewable-generation resource information for Jamundí in Valle del Cauca, Colombia. The research team aggregates NASA POWER, IDEAM and agricultural-institute information and also lists stakeholder survey data, evaluation indicators and study results. Version 1 is freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Although its title begins with Peer review, the repository description explicitly identifies reusable input data for comparing solar, wind, small hydro and biomass options. These regional inputs can support capacity-planning simulations or alternative multicriteria decision analyses. Some derived results require author contact, and the page does not document file formats in the metadata inspected. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
